integrity: The eigenspace formula is proved analytically. The bundled checker replays exact endpoint witnesses and is not used as a substitute for the continuous proof. Originality rests on targeted primary-literature, semantic-record, and prior-ledger comparison, with a stated residual risk of an obscure unindexed correction.
scientific_limitations: The claim is confined to the four-site periodic isotropic Heisenberg chain and its zero-energy one-excitation eigenspace. It does not classify other eigenspaces or chain lengths and does not challenge the Meyer–Wallach measure itself.
title: Degeneracy breaks the claimed one-magnon Meyer–Wallach value
